description: This file is a shell script (.sh) that creates a TRX firmware image by combining kernel and root filesystem files. It calculates headers, padding, and CRCs, and outputs a binary image suitable for flashing devices.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message to standard error and exits the script.

methods.name: padding
methods.description: Generates a padding of zeros (0xFF) of specified length.

methods.name: to_hex
methods.description: Converts binary data to a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: from_hex
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string back to binary data.

methods.name: trx_crc32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum using zytrx tool on combined kernel and rootfs files with padding.

methods.name: tclinux_trx_hdr
methods.description: Builds the TRX header including magic, lengths, CRC, version, and other metadata.
